Offerings

How We Can Help

Whether you're curious about container homes or planning your own build, we're here to help you avoid expensive mistakes and make better decisions.

Experience

Stay & Learn

Spend a weekend at Sustainabox and experience container living firsthand. Every stay includes access to our in-depth build walkthrough and the opportunity to ask questions about every part of the project.

Best for: People exploring container homes before starting their own project.

Learn More
Education

Build Walkthrough

Our recorded four-hour walkthrough covers the entire build — from site preparation and container modifications to insulation, utilities, finishes, and everything in between.

Best for: DIY builders who want to learn at their own pace.

Learn More
1:1 Support

Consulting

Need another set of experienced eyes? Whether you're reviewing plans, deciding between options, or working through a challenge during construction, we offer one-on-one consulting tailored to your project.

  • Design reviews
  • Build sequencing
  • Material selection
  • Budget planning
  • Lessons learned
  • Problem solving

Design Service

SketchUp Design

Share your concept — a rough sketch, a site layout, a list of must-haves — and we'll turn it into a detailed SketchUp model you can actually build from.

Cody designed Sustainabox entirely in SketchUp before a single container was purchased. We'll do the same for you: work through your layout, container configuration, openings, and spatial relationships until the design makes sense on paper and in real life.

Best for: People who have an idea but need it drawn out before talking to a contractor or getting quotes.
